description:
Prepare a human parts enquiry after search_parts and get_part; use prepare_vehicle_handoff for whole cars and get_buying_guide for retail terms.

- part_id fixes the selected item; quantity expresses the buyer's request, even below its minimum. Explain any gap rather than changing the request. Quantity times asking price excludes unconfirmed fees and is not an accepted quote.
- vehicle supplies buyer-provided fitment context; collect missing fields identified by get_part. note qualifies that request but cannot clear fitment restrictions or change eligibility. Never invent vehicle identity.
- A fresh anonymous lookup prepares links only. Text is embedded in the link, so omit unnecessary personal details. The human reviews and decides whether to send; JOY confirms fitment, stock and price. Nothing opens, reserves, orders or charges.

note.description: Buyer-supplied question or preference copied into the prepared enquiry, such as a request to confirm delivery or bulk terms.

part_id.description: Exact part_id from search_parts/get_part for the selected item; not an OEM reference or product URL. The tool fetches fresh public part detail before composing the links.

quantity.description: Number of units the buyer wants to enquire about, included in the prepared message. This is a request count, not a stock allocation.

vehicle.description: Buyer-provided make/model/year, chassis or VIN text for JOY's human fitment review. Omit if the buyer has not supplied vehicle information.

name: prepare_part_handoff
title: Prepare a human parts enquiry
